Support disabling alphabetical grouping in tag cloud
Different from the alphabetical characters, the Chinese characters are diverse and will result in one line, one tag. 

It would be nice to have an option to disable the line break between groups.



Currently I use the Stylus for a workaround:



```css

.tag-cloud .group {

  display: inline;

}

```

from typing import Type

from django.contrib.auth.models import User, AnonymousUser
from django.http import HttpResponse
from django.template import Template, RequestContext
from django.test import TestCase, RequestFactory

from bookmarks.middlewares import UserProfileMiddleware
from bookmarks.tests.helpers import BookmarkFactoryMixin, HtmlTestMixin
from bookmarks.views.partials import contexts


class TagCloudInlineGroupsTest(TestCase, BookmarkFactoryMixin, HtmlTestMixin):
    def render_template(
        self,
        context_type: Type[contexts.TagCloudContext] = contexts.ActiveTagCloudContext,
        url: str = "/test",
        user: User | AnonymousUser = None,
    ):
        rf = RequestFactory()
        request = rf.get(url)
        request.user = user or self.get_or_create_test_user()
        middleware = UserProfileMiddleware(lambda r: HttpResponse())
        middleware(request)

        tag_cloud_context = context_type(request)
        context = RequestContext(request, {"tag_cloud": tag_cloud_context})
        template_to_render = Template("{% include 'bookmarks/tag_cloud.html' %}")
        return template_to_render.render(context)

    def test_default_renders_block_groups(self):
        # Create tags that will produce three alphabetical groups: A, B, C
        tags = [
            self.setup_tag(name="Cockatoo"),
            self.setup_tag(name="Badger"),
            self.setup_tag(name="Buffalo"),
            self.setup_tag(name="Chihuahua"),
            self.setup_tag(name="Alpaca"),
            self.setup_tag(name="Coyote"),
            self.setup_tag(name="Aardvark"),
            self.setup_tag(name="Bumblebee"),
            self.setup_tag(name="Armadillo"),
        ]
        self.setup_bookmark(tags=tags)

        rendered_template = self.render_template()
        soup = self.make_soup(rendered_template)

        # Default behavior should render p.group elements (block) and no span.group
        p_groups = soup.select("p.group")
        span_groups = soup.select("span.group")
        self.assertEqual(len(p_groups), 3)
        self.assertEqual(len(span_groups), 0)

    def test_inline_groups_preference_renders_inline(self):
        # Enable preference on a specific user profile
        user = self.get_or_create_test_user()
        user.profile.search_preferences = {"inline_tag_groups": True}
        user.profile.save()

        tags = [
            self.setup_tag(name="Cockatoo"),
            self.setup_tag(name="Badger"),
            self.setup_tag(name="Buffalo"),
            self.setup_tag(name="Chihuahua"),
            self.setup_tag(name="Alpaca"),
            self.setup_tag(name="Coyote"),
            self.setup_tag(name="Aardvark"),
            self.setup_tag(name="Bumblebee"),
            self.setup_tag(name="Armadillo"),
        ]
        self.setup_bookmark(tags=tags, user=user)

        rendered_template = self.render_template(user=user)
        soup = self.make_soup(rendered_template)

        # With preference enabled, groups should render inline as span.group
        p_groups = soup.select("p.group")
        span_groups = soup.select("span.group")
        self.assertEqual(len(p_groups), 0)
        self.assertEqual(len(span_groups), 3)
